feeds.title: The Ephraims and the Neumeyers
feeds.description: The Ephraims and the Neumeyers blog is primarily focused on the Holocaust and related topics, such as Jewish history, antisemitism, and Holocaust education. The author, Ephraim Neumeyer, is a Holocaust researcher and educator, and many of his articles on the blog are based on his personal research and experiences. Some of the articles are on the author's family history and the impact of the Holocaust on his life.

feeds.title: History of Sorts » Holocaust
feeds.description: I am a Dutch man living in Ireland. Originally from a small former mining town called Geleen in the province of Limburg in the Netherlands. History of Sorts is a site with historical articles and blogs. The majority concern the WWII era but there are also blogs on music, movies, and even serial killers. So overall quite a good mix of stories. I have also written 2 books and I am in the process of writing my 3rd novel, which is fictional but ties in with WWII and the Holocaust.

feeds.title: Doc's Books » Holocaust
feeds.description: DOC'S BOOKS specializes in rare and out-of-print books, with a focus on topics such as history, military history, and biographies. The 'Holocaust' category on the Docs-books blog is a collection of books related to the Holocaust.

feeds.title: Teaching History Matters
feeds.description: 'for the sake of humanity'... A small town American high school history project changes lives worldwide. These are the observations of a veteran teacher- on the Power of Teaching, the importance of the study of History, and especially the lessons we must learn, and teach, on the Holocaust. Click on 'Holocaust Survivors, Liberators Reunited' tab above to begin.

feeds.title: Holocaust Controversies
feeds.description: 'Holocaust Controversies' is a blog dedicated to discussing and debunking various claims and conspiracy theories related to the Holocaust.The blog features posts by a group of contributors, including historians, scholars, and researchers, who analyze and provide evidence to refute various Holocaust-denial claims and revisionist theories.

feeds.title: Jewish Partisan Educational Foundation
feeds.description: JPEF programs, articles, updates, new ideas, and conversations about teaching the history and life lessons of the Jewish partisans. Click here to visit our main site.

feeds.title: Plundered Art
feeds.description: The blog features posts about various cases of art restitution, historical background, legal developments, and current events related to plundered art. The blog also provides links, a bibliography, media, documents, geography, and profiles related to the topic of plundered art. This blog is about the issue of plundered art, especially during the Nazi era and World War II.

feeds.title: The Holocaust Documentation & Education Center
feeds.description: The Holocaust Documentation & Education Center is a nonsectarian, nonprofit organization whose mission is to preserve the authentic memory of the Holocaust.

feeds.title: Remember.org
feeds.description: Remember.org offers contributors (survivors, liberators, historians, family, students and teachers) a place to connect and share the best research resources and stories through art, photography, painting, audio/video, and remembrance.

feeds.title: Claims Conference News
feeds.description: Since 1951 seeking acknowledgment from the German government by negotiating for compensation, restitution and home care for those in need who endured so much. News updates and media information from the Claims Conference.

feeds.title: HAMEC BLOG
feeds.description: We are the only standalone Holocaust Museum in the Greater Philadelphia area -- a population center of nearly 6 million people. Mission Using the resources of the museum, our mission is to educate Delaware Valley students and adults, personalizing the Holocaust so that they learn the consequences of racism, ethnic cleansing, and intolerance.

feeds.title: Holocaust Remembrance Association Blog
feeds.description: Sensitizing HEARTS to the issues of the Holocaust and facilitating healing, reconciliation, and education through marches, scholarships, a garden exhibit and the arts. Learn more about ways you fight antisemitism. The future can only be protected from this ancient hatred by understanding how it grew and spread in the past. Learn more in our Blog and through our digital resources.

feeds.title: Centre for Holocaust Education News
feeds.description: We are the world leader for research informed teacher and student Holocaust education. Part of IOE, UCL's Faculty of Education and Society.

feeds.title: Center for Holocaust & Genocide Studies
feeds.description: The Center for Holocaust & Genocide promotes academic research, education and public awareness on the Shoah, other genocides and current forms of mass violence.

feeds.title: European Holocaust Research Infrastructure Blog
feeds.description: The EHRI document blog is a space to share ideas about Holocaust-related archival documents, and their presentation and interpretation using digital tools.

feeds.title: JFCS Holocaust Center Blog
feeds.description: The Holocaust Center is a program of Jewish Family and Children's Services of San Francisco, the Peninsula, Marin and Sonoma Counties. We are dedicated to remembrance, research, documentation, and education about the Holocaust. Our work increases awareness about Jewish history and the causes and consequences of antisemitism, racism, and discrimination. Through a deeper understanding of the Holocaust and patterns of genocide, our goal is to inspire moral courage and social responsibility in future generations.

feeds.title: Holocaust Centre North Blog
feeds.description: - Holocaust Centre North is open to all, telling a global history of the Holocaust through local stories from the North of England. Based at Huddersfield University.

feeds.title: The Zekelman Holocaust Center Blog
feeds.description: The Zekelman Holocaust Center Blog's mission is to engage, educate, and empower by remembering the Holocaust. Articles and multimedia stories about current exhibitions, events, Holocaust survivor experiences, our artifacts and archives, and resources for students.

feeds.title: Museum of Jewish Heritage Blog
feeds.description: Find blog posts from the Museum of Jewish Heritage -- A Living Memorial to the Holocaust below. Explore Jewish heritage, history, and culture. The Museum is committed to the crucial mission of educating diverse visitors about Jewish life before, during, and after the Holocaust.

feeds.title: Stan Greenspon Holocaust & Social Justice Education Center Blog
feeds.description: Since opening its doors in August 2016, the Stan Greenspon Holocaust and Social Justice Education Center has been building bridges of multicultural understanding and collaboration that champion human rights through education, advocacy, and action. The Stan Greenspon Center blog supports human rights through education, advocacy, organizing and action at Queens University and the Charlotte region.

feeds.title: Lilith Magazine » Holocaust
feeds.description: Independent, Jewish & frankly feminist since 1976, Lilith's mission is to be the feminist change-agent in and for the Jewish community: amplifying Jewish feminist voices, creating an inclusive and positive Judaism, spurring gender consciousness in the Jewish world and empowering women, girls and trans and nonbinary people of every background to envision and enact change in their own lives and the larger community.

feeds.title: Moment Magazine » The Holocaust Education
feeds.description: Moment is an independent magazine known for its award winning journalism and online presence, cultural and literary criticism, and innovative projects. It provides a unique lens on the issues that trouble, concern, and inspire American Jews.

feeds.title: History Extra » Holocaust
feeds.description: The official website for BBC History Magazine and BBC History Revealed

feeds.title: Holocaust Memorial and Tolerance Center of Nassau County News
feeds.description: The Mission of the Holocaust Memorial & Tolerance Center of Nassau County is to teach the history of the Holocaust and its lessons through education and community outreach. We teach about the dangers of antisemitism, racism, bullying and all manifestations of intolerance. We promote resistance to prejudice and advocate respect for every human being.

feeds.title: The Journal of Holocaust research
feeds.description: The Journal of Holocaust Research is a peer-reviewed bilingual (English and Hebrew) scholarly journal devoted to the interdisciplinary study of the Holocaust, its origins, and its aftermath.

feeds.title: Literary Representations of the Holocaust Blog
feeds.description: This blog contains student research from the UBC course on German Representations of the Holocaust (GERM 426) in German literature and film taught by Dr. Uma Kumar in the CENES Department at the University of British Columbia.The focus is on the victims: the Jewish people as well as the lesser known other victims of the Holocaust. They were, among others, political opponents, gay men and women, Sinti & Roma, Jehovah's witnesses, and Soviet Prisoners of War.

feeds.title: The National Archives Blog » Holocaust Memorial Day
feeds.description: Official archive of the UK government. Discover our online collections, research guides and educational resources, spanning 1000 years of history.

feeds.title: Holocaust Center of Pittsburgh
feeds.description: Inspiring engagement with Holocaust history and connecting it to today. The Holocaust Center of Pittsburgh connects the horrors of the Holocaust and antisemitism with the injustices of today. Through education, the Holocaust Center seeks to address these injustices and empower individuals to build a more civil and humane society.

feeds.title: Chapman University Blog » Holocaust
feeds.description: The mission of Chapman University is to provide personalized education of distinction that leads to inquiring, ethical, and productive lives as global citizens.

feeds.title: Vanished World Blog
feeds.description: Vanished World is a personal blog that aims to recall neglected Jewish cemeteries, ruins of synagogues, and other remains of Jewish institutions in Eastern Europe into public consciousness and wants to encourage people to the rescue of heritage we all share. The blog also contains posts about the author's travels to different places in Eastern Europe and their experiences there.

feeds.title: The Wiener Holocaust Library News
feeds.description: The Wiener Holocaust Library is one of the world's leading and most extensive archives on the Holocaust, the Nazi era and genocide. The Library's unique collection of over one million items includes published and unpublished works, press cuttings, photographs and eyewitness testimony.

feeds.title: Sydney Jewish Museum Blog
feeds.description: The Sydney Jewish Museum gives history a voice through collecting and preserving historic objects, commemorating and educating, with a mission to challenge visitors' perceptions of morality, social justice, democracy and human rights.

feeds.title: The Times of Israel Blog » Holocaust
feeds.description: The Times of Israel is a Jerusalem-based online newspaper founded in 2012 to document developments in Israel, the Middle East and around the Jewish world. It was established by veteran UK-born, Israeli journalist David Horovitz and his US-based capital partner Seth Klarman. Horovitz is the founding editor, responsible for the site's editorial content.
